name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> form, no Ghidra address residue. '24x24' is the sprite dimension (semantic), 'window_relative' accurately captures that the destination address is computed relative to the battle-view window origin after a window-visibility clip. Inputs are world/absolute tile coords; the function clips them to the window and translates to a window-relative dst offset. Name faithfully reflects purpose and internal logic; keep.
purpose: Paint a 24x24 cursor/UI sprite at world tile coords into the battle render workspace, but only when the tile is visible inside the battle view window; out-of-window calls are silent no-ops.
logic_summary: Compiler __CHK(0x18) stack-probe prologue, then a window-visibility test: origin_x <= world_x < origin_x+max_x AND origin_y <= world_y < origin_y+max_y. If inside, resolve the sprite source from the runtime-battle-state cursor atlas via its +6 offset table (sprite_src = atlas_base + *(int*)(atlas_base + 6 + sprite_idx*4)); compute the destination inside data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer at +0x8088 with row stride 0x2AC0 (24 rows * 0x1C8 pitch) and column stride 0x18 (24 bytes/tile); tail-call fd2_tile_blit_24x24_passthrough(sprite_src, dst, 0x1C8). Out-of-window -> no-op return.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_blit_24x24_at_window_relative_pos(uint32 world_x, uint32 world_y, uint32 sprite_idx)
